prompts: The match server of our game hangs under load, and the final scores come out low. The score board is the crate in {WS}. Find out why and fix it. Its public API stays as it is, the tests in {WS}/tests stay as they are, and the crate takes no new dependencies.
answers:
[goal] Fix why the score board hangs under load and reports low scores.
[action] Rewrote `src/lib.rs` internals only; public API and `tests/board.rs` unchanged, no new dependencies.
[result] Root causes: `award` read-then-wrote player and total scores in separate lock acquisitions (lost updates → low scores); `transfer` locked the same slot twice when from == to (deadlock) and locked two slots in arbitrary order (deadlock when two threads transfer opposite pairs). Now a single `Mutex<State>` guards the map and total; `transfer` returns early when from == to. `cargo test` passes (1/1); I also ran a throwaway concurrent test (8 threads × 2000 award/transfer, incl. same-player transfer) that confirmed total == sum of scores and no hang — removed afterward.

Assumption: `join` keeps its original semantics (re-joining an id overwrites and adds to total), preserving existing behavior.

[next] none.
